---
title: "Every region, side by side"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
all <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
rates <- all |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom") |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(change = last(rate) - first(rate)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(region = fct_reorder(region, change,
                              .desc = TRUE))
riser <- rates |>
  filter(change > 0) |>
  distinct(region) |>
  pull(region)
kingdom <- all |>
  filter(region == "Kingdom") |>
  select(-region)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(rates, aes(date, rate)) +
  geom_line(data = kingdom, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_line(aes(colour = change > 0), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(vars(region), ncol = 5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#00803A",
                                 `FALSE` = "#4137A8"),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year",
               date_labels = "'%y") +
  labs(title = str_glue(
         "Against the Kingdom, only {riser} ",
         "moved the other way"),
       subtitle = str_glue(
         "Unemployment rate, %. Grey: the Kingdom. ",
         "Ordered by the change since ",
         "{min(rates$quarter)}"),
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
